desc: Derive the DP recurrence: eliminate segment-index t via the "cut surcharge" trick (each cut at j adds k*(C[n]-C[j]) for all later segments); fold fictitious j=0 surcharge into final subtraction of k*C[n].
Confirm O(n^2) suffices (n ≤ 1000 → ~5*10^5 ops); CHT optimization unnecessary.
Implement prefix sums S, C and the O(n^2) DP in the starter code; answer = dp[n] - k*C[n]; use Python ints (values up to ~10^15).
Test on both provided examples (110 ✓, 985 ✓) plus edge cases.
Cross-validate with brute-force enumerator over all 2^(n-1) partitions for n ≤ 8 random arrays — all matched.
